'''Infotech Plaza''' was a plaza in the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:NSD" />
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Infotech Plaza appears as part of the Network Security District on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:NSD" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
